title: general_name_matches falls back to DER encode+compare
description:
In pkix-revocation/src/crl.rs:1320-1324, the non-DirectoryName arm of general_name_matches encodes both GeneralName values to DER and compares the resulting byte buffers. This allocates two Vecs per comparison for non-DN GeneralName types.

What goes wrong: For CRLs with IDP using URI-type distribution points, every CDP-vs-IDP comparison pair allocates two DER-encoding buffers. In practice IDP/CDP entries are overwhelmingly DirectoryName (which takes the fast names_match path) or URIs (typically 1-2 entries), so the cost is small. But the allocation is gratuitous when both sides are the same variant - for example, two UniformResourceIdentifier values could be compared via their inner IA5String directly.

Location: pkix-revocation/src/crl.rs:1320-1324

Recommendation: Match on same-variant pairs (URI==URI, DnsName==DnsName, etc.) and compare inner values directly; only fall back to DER encoding for cross-variant comparisons.
